snippet: THE BLOCK: China, Japan, South Korea, and ASEAN member countries have agreed to set up a dedicated working group on cross-border digital payments and digital asset regulation. Finance ministers and central bank governors will further discuss the matter at the next meeting in Nagoya in May 2027.
